title: Going on Holiday
intro: We're going to go on holiday!

words.sentence: We're going to buy our train tickets today.
words.def: You need this to get on a train or a plane.

parentTip.vi: Trước chuyến đi, cùng con soạn đồ và nói "We're going to take a torch. What are you going to take?"
parentTip.say: What are you going to take on holiday?

chat.ask: Are you going to go camping?
chat.yes: Cool! Sleeping in a tent is fun!
chat.no: Okay! A hotel is nice too!

text.title: Our Camping Trip
lines: Next weekend, my family is going to go camping by a lake.
We're going to sleep in a big tent.
I am going to carry the food in my backpack.
At night, we are going to look at the stars with a torch.
